svg.title: The journey so far, 2021 to 2026
svg.desc: A timeline drawn as one green line. 2021: 22 repos learning the web. 2022 and 2023: 14 university repos in Java, Oracle and Python. 2024: Shohan Theme, a VS Code theme. 2024: create-3np-stack, a full-stack app from one npx. 2025: TaskGrid, project management, in real time. 2025: notionuxt, a Notion-style editor for Vue. 2025: Pengine, a print-on-demand storefront. 2025: Rooktoo, blood donation, with an AI assistant. 2026: DoctorProjukti, a healthcare ecosystem. 2026: Matra, a rich text editor framework, from scratch. Matra is at HEAD.
